echo "=== files missing 'import sys' among hardened files ==="; for f in scripts/import-workflow-transcript.py scripts/create_issue_benchmark.py scripts/create_issue_eval.py scripts/export-workflow-lifecycle-census.py scripts/implement-context-eval.py scripts/import-review-verdict-handoff.py scripts/focused_selection.py scripts/env-propagation-probe-verdict.py scripts/extract-execution-cost.py; do grep -qE '^import sys' "$f" || echo "MISSING import sys: $f"; done; echo "=== done ==="

grep -rl '_force_utf8_streams' scripts/ lib/ --include='*.py' | grep -vF '/test/' > /tmp/hardened.txt 2>/dev/null; wc -l /tmp/hardened.txt; echo "=== of those, lacking import sys ==="; cat /tmp/hardened.txt | xargs grep -L '^import sys' 2>/dev/null

echo "=== ALL tracked *.py with a module-body __main__ block, by top dir ==="
for f in $(git ls-files '*.py'); do
  if grep -qE '^if __name__ == "__main__":' "$f"; then echo "$f"; fi
done | tee .prflow/tmp/allcmds.txt | sed -E 's#/.*##' | sort | uniq -c

for f in $(git ls-files -- 'scripts/*.py' 'lib/*.py' | grep -v '^lib/test/'); do
  if grep -q '__main__' "$f"; then
    if ! grep -q '_force_utf8_streams\|reconfigure(encoding="utf-8"' "$f"; then
      echo "MISSING: $f"
    fi
  fi
done; echo "done"

git ls-files -- 'scripts/*.py' 'lib/*.py' | grep -v '^lib/test/' > /tmp/pyfiles.txt
while IFS= read -r f; do
  if grep -q '__main__' "$f"; then
    if ! grep -qE '_force_utf8_streams|reconfigure\(encoding="utf-8"' "$f"; then
      echo "MISSING: $f"
    fi
  fi
done < /tmp/pyfiles.txt
echo "done; total commands:"; grep -lE '__main__' $(cat /tmp/pyfiles.txt) | wc -l
